summary.en: Read class compartments, relationship arrows and multiplicities, then map a model to Java.
summary.bn: ক্লাসের অংশ, সম্পর্কের চিহ্ন ও সংখ্যার সীমা পড়ে জাভা কোডে রূপ দিন।

notes: UML notation is language independent; the translations here use Java 17.

sections.title: Sketch the promises before writing the classes
Read boxes, symbols and relationship ends
Turn a small model into maintained constraints
Make every arrow a claim you can explain

examples.title: Translate attributes and operations
examples.explanationHtml: The diagram’s private roll attribute becomes a field. The public roll operation becomes a method with an int result.

examples.title: Enforce a bounded association
examples.explanationHtml: The model permits zero to two students per lab. add rejects a third object and null, maintaining that upper bound.

practice.title: Read a library model
practice.statementHtml: Library has an association to Book with 0..* at the Book end and 1 at the Library end. Explain both ends without claiming ownership.
practice.answerHtml: One Library is associated with zero or more Books. Each Book is associated with exactly one Library in this model. Multiplicity states counts, not ownership. Add a composition diamond only if books are exclusively owned parts whose model lifetime follows the library.
hints: Read the opposite end from one instance.

practice.title: Choose the correct diamond
practice.statementHtml: An Order creates LineItems and does not share them with another Order. A Club references independently existing Students. Draw and justify the relationships.
practice.answerHtml:
Order "1" *-- "1..*" LineItem
Club "0..*" -- "0..*" Student

The filled diamond at Order expresses exclusive part ownership. Club and Student use an ordinary association because either can exist independently. A hollow aggregation diamond is optional only when a weak whole-part meaning adds useful information.
hints: Ask whether a part may belong to two wholes simultaneously.

practice.title: Map required and optional links
practice.statementHtml: A Student has one required Advisor and zero or one Locker. Give Java field fragments and construction policies.
practice.answerHtml:
private final Advisor advisor;
private Locker locker;

Reject a null Advisor in construction to enforce the required link. locker may be null when no locker is assigned. Assignment and release operations must preserve the maximum of one locker. A single reference cannot enforce the reverse-end count by itself.

practice.title: Translate inheritance and realization
practice.statementHtml: Draw Scholar inheriting Student and implementing Payable. Explain arrow shapes and Java keywords.
practice.answerHtml:
Scholar --|> Student
Scholar ..|> Payable

The solid generalization line uses a hollow triangle at Student. The dashed realization line uses a hollow triangle at Payable. Java maps these to extends Student and implements Payable respectively.
hints: The triangle points toward the general contract.

quiz.prompt: What do the three usual class compartments contain?
quiz.explanation: The class box describes structure and behaviour, not one object’s memory address.

quiz.prompt: What does -mark: int mean inside a class box?
quiz.explanation: The minus sign denotes private visibility and the colon introduces the type.
options: A private int attribute named mark

quiz.explanation: Parentheses indicate an operation; plus indicates public visibility.

quiz.prompt: Where does the hollow inheritance triangle point?
quiz.explanation: The arrow points to the more general type.
options: Toward the object with more fields

quiz.prompt: What does 0..1 at the Locker end mean for one Student?
quiz.explanation: Read the count at the far end from a single instance at the near end.
options: A locker has exactly one student
The student may have no locker or one locker
The student must have at least one locker

quiz.prompt: Which multiplicity permits zero or arbitrarily many associated objects?
quiz.explanation: The lower bound is zero and star means no finite upper bound in the model.

quiz.prompt: Which relation promises exclusive part ownership?
quiz.explanation: A composition part belongs to at most one composite at a time.

quiz.prompt: Where is a composition diamond placed?
quiz.explanation: The diamond marks the owner or composite, not its contained part.

quiz.prompt: What Java relationship usually maps to dashed realization?
quiz.explanation: Realization means a class supplies an interface contract.

quiz.prompt: Does a Student[] field alone enforce a 1..30 association?
quiz.explanation: Null slots and updates matter. The program must preserve the model constraints.
options: No, operations must maintain the lower and upper bounds
Yes, every array slot is a Student
Yes, array length equals live count

keyPoints.en: A class diagram describes types rather than individual instances.
keyPoints.bn: ক্লাস ডায়াগ্রাম নির্দিষ্ট অবজেক্টের বদলে টাইপের গঠন দেখায়।

keyPoints.en: Visibility symbols connect diagram members to Java access.
keyPoints.bn: ভিজিবিলিটির চিহ্ন দিয়ে ডায়াগ্রামের মেম্বারকে জাভার অ্যাক্সেসে মেলানো যায়।

keyPoints.en: Read multiplicity at the far end of each association.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যাসোসিয়েশনের অপর প্রান্তের সংখ্যা পড়ে সম্পর্কের সীমা বুঝুন।

keyPoints.en: Composition adds exclusive ownership to a whole-part relation.
keyPoints.bn: কম্পোজিশনে whole-part সম্পর্কের সঙ্গে একক মালিকানার শর্ত থাকে।

keyPoints.en: Code must enforce the constraints drawn in the model.
keyPoints.bn: মডেলে দেখানো সীমা কোডের মাধ্যমে বজায় রাখতে হয়।

examQuestions.question: Draw a Course with a code attribute, a title operation and zero to thirty Students.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
+-------------------+
| Course            |
| - code: String    |
| + title(): String |
+-------------------+
Course "0..*" -- "0..30" Student

One Course links to at most thirty Students. The chosen reverse multiplicity permits a student to take many courses. Admission operations must reject a thirty-first student.

examQuestions.question: Compare association, aggregation, composition and inheritance.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Association states a link. Shared aggregation adds a weak whole-part interpretation, shown with a hollow diamond. Composition adds exclusive part ownership, shown with a filled diamond. Inheritance is an is-a relation with a hollow triangle pointing to the parent. None should be selected merely because one class mentions another.

examQuestions.question: Explain why Java garbage collection does not implement UML composition by itself.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Garbage collection reclaims unreachable objects according to runtime reachability. UML composition describes model ownership and lifetime responsibility. External aliases may keep a part reachable. A design must control sharing and invalid use rather than assuming a diamond forces immediate memory reclamation.
